as_told.title: Ted Owens' powers from the mantids Twitter and Tweeter

plain: Ted Owens, a man who claimed psychic powers from about the 1960s to the 1980s, said he got those powers from insect-like beings in a huge invisible UFO hovering over the Earth. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove repeats Owens' own words: he used psychokinesis, the supposed power to move things with the mind, and sent "telepathic messages to my friends, the space intelligences", and "they do it". The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells the same story in another episode and adds that Owens named the mantis-like beings "Twitter and Tweeter" and placed them in a saucer. If true, a human being would have had direct mental contact with alien beings who acted on his requests.
